description: Permanently deletes a note from a job application's timeline. This action cannot be undone — confirm with the user before calling. Use list_job_application_notes to find the note UUID if you don't have it.

application_id.description: UUID of the job application this note belongs to.

note_uuid.description: UUID of the note to delete. Returned by add_job_application_note or list_job_application_notes.

name: delete_job_application_note
